name: Embedding Service
shortDescription: Self-hosted text embedding API with Hugging Face Text Embeddings Inference (TEI), optional reranker
description:
Runs [Hugging Face Text Embeddings Inference](https://github.com/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference) (TEI) 1.9.4 as an HTTP API for text embeddings. The default model is `BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5` (English, 768 dimensions); any embedding model TEI supports can be set with one variable. The model is downloaded on first start and kept in a volume.

The API offers TEI's own `/embed` route and an OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` route, so tools that speak the OpenAI embeddings format can use it by changing the base URL. TEI batches concurrent requests on the server. An optional second service runs a reranker model (`BAAI/bge-reranker-base` by default) behind `/rerank`.

The default setup runs on CPU, binds ports to localhost and can require an API key. A Compose override and Terraform variables switch to the CUDA image for NVIDIA GPUs. The Helm chart in this stack adds a Kubernetes deployment with a model cache volume and optional autoscaling and ingress; the AWS Terraform runs the same containers on one EC2 instance.
requirements: x86_64 CPU (for ARM64 use the cpu-arm64-1.9.4 image)
About 2 GB of free RAM for the default model (it used about 1.3 GB in our test); more for large models
About 1 GB of disk for the CPU image and the default model; the reranker model adds about 1.1 GB
Internet access on first start to download the model from Hugging Face
Optional: NVIDIA GPU with the NVIDIA Container Toolkit (the CUDA image is about 3 GB compressed)

envVariables.name: EMBED_MODEL_REVISION
envVariables.description: Model revision (branch, tag or commit hash)

envVariables.name: EMBED_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for the embeddings API, bound to 127.0.0.1

envVariables.name: API_KEY
envVariables.description: Optional API key; requests then need 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32

envVariables.name: HF_TOKEN
envVariables.description: Hugging Face token, only for gated or private models

envVariables.name: MAX_CLIENT_BATCH_SIZE
envVariables.description: Maximum number of inputs per request

envVariables.name: AUTO_TRUNCATE
envVariables.description: Truncate inputs longer than the model's maximum length instead of returning an error

envVariables.name: COMPOSE_PROFILES
envVariables.description: Set to reranker to also start the reranker service

envVariables.name: RERANK_MODEL_ID
envVariables.description: Hugging Face model for the reranker

envVariables.name: RERANK_PORT
envVariables.description: Host port for the reranker API, bound to 127.0.0.1
